message:
The other night, we had a surprise power outage that caught me off guard. As I fumbled for the flashlight in the kitchen drawer, my family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree! My kids started sending each other funny memes about our ‘candlelight dinner’ plan that quickly turned into laughter over who was going to be the ‘light keeper’ with their trusty power bank. 

It was a great reminder that while we may lose power, we never lose our sense of humor. I ended up gathering some snacks and we all snuggled up with our flashlights, sharing stories and cracking jokes until the lights came back on. 

So, it’s nice to be prepared with a few essentials for these moments, but let’s not forget to enjoy the unexpected family time! What’s your favorite way to stay connected during a blackout?
